description: The fixed error codes every tool returns with ok false, in the error object of the response envelope. Codes never change and are never reused. Source: document 24, section 3.5. HTTP status follows document 25, section 7.
retryableMeans: True when the same call, unchanged, may succeed later. False when something must change first: sign in, fix the input, re-read the record, get a role, or wait for an admin to fix the configuration.
engineReasonsMeans: Examples of engine reason codes (document 25) that map to the code. Not a full list. A trailing .* means every code with that prefix.

codes.meaning: No valid token. The HTTP layer returns 401 with the protected resource metadata link.
codes.clientAction: Sign in through the MCP client, then call again.

codes.meaning: Valid token, but the caller lacks the role, the owner role, or the row access. A missing scope also returns 403.
codes.clientAction: Tell the person which role or ownership the call needs. Do not retry.

codes.meaning: The write would set a state that only a person or the approval runner may set. AI never approves.
codes.clientAction: Do not retry. Point the person to the approval card or to the page where a person acts.

codes.meaning: A configuration rule refused the write, for example a gate requirement or a window rule. ruleKey names the refusing row.
codes.clientAction: Explain the rule to the person. Change the input, or start the decision the rule needs.

codes.meaning: An input is missing, malformed or not an allowed key.
codes.clientAction: Fix the field named in error.field, then call again.

codes.meaning: The ID or key does not exist, or the caller cannot see it.
codes.clientAction: Check the ID or key, for example with find_applications.

codes.meaning: The record changed since it was read, the baseVersionNumber is stale, or a clientRequestId was reused with a different payload.
codes.clientAction: Read the record again, then call again with the fresh state.

codes.meaning: The write touches a locked setting or an engine contract value.
codes.clientAction: Do not retry. A locked value does not change through any tool.

codes.meaning: The Tool Policy limit of calls per person per hour was reached. The error carries retryAfterSeconds.
codes.clientAction: Wait for retryAfterSeconds, then call again.

codes.meaning: A Microsoft API the tool needs did not answer, for example the inventory or Microsoft Graph.
codes.clientAction: Wait a little, then call again. For the gap check, compare_inventory_list is the fallback.

codes.meaning: The engine cannot load a valid active configuration version, or a rule row it needs is missing, such as a gate policy row. Governed writes are refused. There is no built-in fallback.
codes.clientAction: Tell the person the configuration is broken and a configuration admin must fix it. get_configuration_health shows the cause.
